learning_outcomes.text: Explain realistic AI use cases across entrepreneurs and small-business operations
Use AI tools effectively and ground their output
Use AI to support marketing and product content
Apply AI to support operations and customer service
Govern AI use for risk, confidentiality and accuracy and consumer fairness
Lead responsible, ethical AI adoption in entrepreneurs and small-business operations

Map suitable use cases, use AI to draft marketing content and support service with grounding and review, classify customer and business data and design an approval and audit trail, plan a safe pilot, and set a policy covering accuracy, consumer fairness and disclosure.
